name: 07869 · Randolph, NJ
findings: ZIP 07869 (Randolph) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07869 (Randolph) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
